about.duplicates: rows whose exact feature values (float32) occur more than once in the whole file
about.conflicts: rows whose exact feature values also occur with another attack type of the same family (same_family) or with another family (cross_family)
about.twins: validation / test rows whose exact feature values also occur in that fold's training rows
about.ceiling: scores of the rule 'every group of identical feature rows gets its most common label in the block'; no model using these features can be more accurate on that block (for macro-F1 a reference, not a strict maximum). Macro-F1 over classes with true rows (EVAL-1 2.1)
about.screen: AUC of one feature for 100-packet-window families (DDoS, DoS, Mirai) against the others, family-balanced sample; separation = |AUC - 0.5| * 2 (0 none, 1 perfect); within_side = the same between families that share a window size
about.counts: rows, shares and twins count rows of the cleaned file; only the ceiling weights rows by 1 / sample_rate (all 1.0 with D8's --per-label-cap 0)

iat_cleaned.source: cleaned file (float32: values above 2^24 = 16,777,216 are rounded, so distinct counts there are lower bounds of the raw ones; the direction of change is kept)

sample.weights: family-balanced: every family weighs the same inside its side, every attack type the same inside its family
